title: S key now dual-dispatches: opens the settings panel AND issues a logged sim command (Set_Lane Standard) when a pipe is selected
evidence:
phase-1 (7.3 addition, mouse.odin:152-153):
		case .S:
			append(out, Intent(Toggle_Settings{}))
pre-existing phase-2 (mouse.odin:388-389):
		case .S:
			append(out, Intent(Set_Lane{lane = pp.LANE_STANDARD}))
mouse.odin:357:
	phase2_blocked := has_right || (has_left && (ui || tray_hit || placing_eff >= 0)) || inp.panel_open
exec.odin:193-196:
	case Set_Lane:
		// the E/S/B lane keys (gated on the selection + the class index)
		if inp.sel_pipe >= 0 && u32(inp.sel_class) < u32(len(inp.cat.packet_types)) {
			set_lane_class(inp, inp.sel_class, v.lane)
detail: On a key-only S frame phase2_blocked is false (panel still closed at map time), so both intents emit; executor's Set_Lane has no panel guard and set_lane_class appends Cmd_Set_Lane to the action log. Opening settings silently mutates pipe QoS + pollutes replay.
recommended_fix: Suppress the phase-2 E/S/B lane mapping on frames where S mapped to Toggle_Settings (e.g. gate phase-2 S/E/B on !panel-opening, or consume S in phase-1 like the P/Space coalescing pattern).

title: Modal-gate order differs per device at Game_Over, and start_run never resets panel_open/panel_row
evidence: controller.odin gates the panel BEFORE Game_Over (line 34 `if inp.panel_open {` precedes line 51 `if inp.mode == .Game_Over {`), so pad Y opens the panel at Game_Over. mouse.odin:37-47 returns after R/Enter handling BEFORE the panel key gate at line 125; touch.odin:25-27 returns at Game_Over before its panel gate at line 31. start_run (app/main.odin) resets drag/sel/placing/press/pad state but never panel_open or panel_row.
detail: Pad can open the panel at Game_Over; keyboard S/Esc then cannot close it (Game_Over early-return swallows them), and R/Enter retry carries panel_open into the fresh run — the new run starts modal-blocked and unpaused. Cross-device parity asymmetry by construction.
recommended_fix: Gate Game_Over before the panel in controller.odin (match mouse/touch), or make the Game_Over branches panel-aware; also clear inp.panel_open/panel_row in start_run alongside the other input-state resets.

title: QoS panel mixes scaled and unscaled geometry in one row — [Edit weights] and [Revert] overlap at x1.25/x1.50 and the overlap mis-hits
detail: At x1.50 slot 0 spans [30,210], slot 1 [148,238]: 62px of Revert is shadowed by slot 0 (in auto mode it opens the editor instead of reverting); at x1.25, 27px. The manual editor's chips/nudges also never grow — the a11y knob misses the panel's smallest hit targets.
recommended_fix: Route every rect in qos_action_rect/qos_preset_chip_rect/qos_nudge_rect through hud()/hud_f() (including the +136/96px slots), so the whole row scales from the same single source.

title: Popover scaling is partial: width/offsets/button insets scale, but panel height and all text stay at x1.00 constants
evidence:
POPOVER_H_NODE :: f32(92)
POPOVER_H_PIPE :: f32(64)
passed unscaled: `pop := popover_rect(v, node_screen(v, topo.node_pos[slot]), POPOVER_H_NODE)` (line 97, same at 108), while popover_rect scales only w/offsets via hud_f. Text unscaled: `draw_text_c(v, cat.node_types[topo.node_type[slot]].display, i32(pop.x) + 10, i32(pop.y) + 8, 15, p.ink)` (line 99) and the demolish label at fixed 14 (line 129).
detail: The PR claims hud() threads through the popover, but height + text opt out silently — two conventions inside one surface. Draw and hit-test stay consistent (shared rects), so no mis-hit; the debt is that future editors will assume full scaling.
recommended_fix: Either scale h + the popover text sizes through hud()/hud_f() too, or add a comment stating the popover deliberately scales width-only.

title: pulse_read documented as the ONE motion-gate seam, but the crisis outline hand-rolls a second gate
detail: Two reduced-motion gating patterns now exist; the crisis outline's phase math ((tick+b)%16) doesn't match pulse_factor's ((tick+id*5)*advance&15), so it couldn't call pulse_read verbatim. A third consumer has no enforced single gate and the seam doc is inaccurate.
recommended_fix: Generalize pulse_read (or add a pulse_read_phase(v, phase)) so the crisis outline routes through the same seam; fix the crisis comment to name the actual gate.

title: demolish_button_rect's nil-default view silently reproduces the unscaled rect — a second source of truth for the button geometry
detail: Any caller omitting the view gets x1.00 math while draw_demolish_popover draws scaled — the single-source rect rule the PR champions is now opt-out by omission. Only four call sites exist; the fallback buys nothing a required parameter wouldn't.
recommended_fix: Make v a required parameter and update the two harness call sites, deleting the nil fallback so scaled and hit-test rects cannot diverge silently.
